description: This file defines the Cart class within the Opencart system, providing methods for managing shopping cart operations such as adding, removing, updating products, and calculating totals, taxes, weight, and other cart-related data.
external_files: opencart/other related tables and classes (e.g., product, product_description, product_option, etc.)

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: A class encapsulating shopping cart functionalities such as adding, updating, removing products, and calculating totals, taxes, weight, and stock status.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the current products in the cart, populating detailed info including options, subscription data, downloads, stock status, price, total, reward points, points, weight, and other product-specific data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart with specified options, quantity, subscription plan ID, and override data. If the product with the same options exists, increments the quantity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specified cart item by cart ID.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains an item with the specified cart ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart based on cart ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns all products in the cart that are subscription-based.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates the total weight of shippable products in the cart, converting units as necessary.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal amount of all products in the cart.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Calculates tax amounts for products in the cart based on tax rates and classes.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total cost including taxes for all products in the cart.

methods.name: countProducts
methods.description: Counts the total quantity of all products in the cart.

methods.name: hasProducts
methods.description: Checks if there are any products in the cart.

methods.name: hasSubscription
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains any subscription products.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Verifies if all products in the cart are in stock.

methods.name: hasMinimum
methods.description: Checks if all products meet their minimum order quantities.

methods.name: hasShipping
methods.description: Determines if any products in the cart require shipping.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Determines if any products in the cart have downloadable content.
